bhawaiyaandbhatial.title: Bhawaiya
bhawaiyaandbhatial.quote: Bhawaiya is a musical form or a popular folk music that originated in Northern Bengal , especially the Rangpur Division in Bangladesh

bhawaiyaandbhatial.title: Bhawaiya
bhawaiyaandbhatial.quote: Bhawaiya is generally believed to have originated in the 16th century under Biswa Singha

bhawaiyaandbhatial.title: Bhawaiya
bhawaiyaandbhatial.quote: It has recurrent themes of the "working class", mahouts , mahishals (buffalo herders), and gariyals (cart drivers).

bhawaiyaandbhatial.title: Bhawaiya
bhawaiyaandbhatial.quote: Bhawaiya may be of two types: one draws out the voice in melancholy notes, while the other has a chatka or skipping tone.

bhawaiyaandbhatial.title: Bhawaiya
bhawaiyaandbhatial.quote: The two-stringed dotara is the main musical accompaniment.

bhawaiyaandbhatial.title: Bhatiali

bhawaiyaandbhatial.title: Bhatiyali

maracatu.title: Maracatu
maracatu.quote: Maracatu nação (also known as maracatu de baque virado : "maracatu of the turned-around beat"), the most well-known of the maracatu genres, is an Afro-Brazilian performance genre practiced in the state of Pernambuco , mainly in the cities of Recife and Olinda .

maracatu.title: Maracatu

maracatu.title: Maracatu

hardangerfiddleand.title: Hardanger fiddle
hardangerfiddleand.quote: The earliest known example of the hardingfele is from 1651, made by Ole Jonsen Jaastad in Hardanger , Norway .

hardangerfiddleand.title: Hardanger fiddle
hardangerfiddleand.quote: Four of the strings are strung and played like a violin, while the rest, named understrings or sympathetic strings , resonate under the influence of the other four.

hardangerfiddleand.title: Hardanger fiddle
hardangerfiddleand.quote: The hardingfele is used for dancing, accompanied by rhythmic loud foot stomping.

hardangerfiddleand.title: Hardanger fiddle
hardangerfiddleand.quote: The player usually bows on two of the upper strings at a time, and sometimes three.

hardangerfiddleand.title: Hardanger fiddle
hardangerfiddleand.quote: In Norway, more than 20 different tunings are recorded.

hardangerfiddleand.title: Bygdedans
hardangerfiddleand.quote: The music accompanying bygdedans is normally seen as the oldest living musical traditions in the country.

hardangerfiddleand.title: Bygdedans
hardangerfiddleand.quote: The basic form of the bygdedans is the gangar (walking dance in 2/4 or 3/8) and the springar (running dance in even rhythm or 3/4)

hardangerfiddleand.title: Bygdedans
hardangerfiddleand.quote: For instance in Telemark the pulse is best characterised as longer – long – short, whereas in Valdres it is short – longer – long.

hardangerfiddleand.title: Bygdedans
hardangerfiddleand.quote: The areas of bygdedans correlate mainly with the regions where the hardanger fiddle is used as the main folk music instrument.
